# Voss Jr.

The son and heir of [[characters/voss]], Voss Jr. represents the next generation of leadership within the Crimson Order. Though young, he has already begun to prove himself as a capable commander in his own right.

## Training

Voss Jr. was raised and trained by his father in the ways of war and governance, learning the lessons that shaped the Crimson Order into the military force it is today.

## Future

Many within the Order look to Voss Jr. as the future of their faction, hoping he will one day surpass his father's achievements.
